### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/95783727c9c18ee48846a02d4a4d1a1b1aad8af3/src/operationalMemory/taskQueue.ts#L409 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Reject foreign-owned READY tasks before claiming** When session A transitions a `CLAIMED` task back to `READY`—an explicitly allowed transition—`transitionTask` preserves `ownerGovernedSessionId`. The new selection path can still return that task for session B because eligibility only checks TargetScope, after which the claim overwrites A's ownership. This violates the advertised no-stealing guarantee and can transfer active work between sessions; exclude candidates owned by another session (or clear ownership as part of the transition that requeues them).

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eaacf048f50ab9ecbaec252b55b0492a43ff0629/src/github/serverResolution.ts#L47-L50 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Reject malformed server-map entries before resolving** When `.mcp/server-map.json` parses but contains an invalid entry such as `{"servers":{"S1":null}}`, this function examines only the key, returns `s1` as canonical, and allows valid registry evidence to produce a `RESOLVED` server. That turns a malformed authority into confirmed server identity instead of failing closed; validate the map schema and each server entry before intersecting its IDs with `managedServerIds`. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L32-L32](https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eaacf048f50ab9ecbaec252b55b0492a43ff0629/AGENTS.md#L32-L32) --- https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eaacf048f50ab9ecbaec252b55b0492a43ff0629/src/governedContext/github.ts#L1363-L1365 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Expose C3 resolution to non-MCP sessions** When a governed session targets any repository other than `Patricked-code/MCP`, `compose()` in `src/governedContext/service.ts` takes its `session.repository !== HISTORICAL_REPOSITORY` fallback and never invokes this collector, so the newly added `serverResolution` is absent for every multi-repository target session. This leaves C3 usable only for the historical MCP repository rather than the project-scoped sessions introduced by B3.2; preserve the unavailable MCP work-state projection while still running or attaching the identity/project/server-resolution chain for the target repository. --- https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/eaacf048f50ab9ecbaec252b55b0492a43ff0629/src/github/registry.ts#L225-L226 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Reject verified bindings without a real path** For a schema-V2 registry mapping with `realPath: null` and `realPathVerified: true`, the existing registry schema accepts the record and these new projection fields preserve the contradiction; `ServerBindingSchema` also accepts it, so C3 can return `RESOLVED` with a binding claiming verification but containing no real path. Treat this cross-field combination as invalid registry evidence, or require a non-null absolute `realPath` whenever `realPathVerified` is true.
